violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: GRILLED CHICKEN (OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED/SEARED IN THE WALK-IN COOLER).
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS DISCUSSED REQUIREMENTS OF THE NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS. PIC HAS AGREED TO ENSURE GRILLED CHICKEN IS SEARED AND IMMEDIATELY BAKED TO 165F IN THE FUTURE. IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WOULD LIKE TO DO NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS IN THE FUTURE, PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS PRIOR TO DOING SO AS WRITTEN PLANS/TEMPERATURE DOCUMENTATION IS REQUIRED.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not prepared and stored according to written procedures: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED GRILLED CHICKEN IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be prepared and stored according to written procedures that have obtained approval from the regulatory authority, are maintained in the food establishment and are available to the regulatory authority upon request, describe hot the requirements are to be monitored and documented and corrective actions taken, describe how the foods are to be marked as foods that must be further cooked, describe how the foods are to be separated from ready-to-eat foods. EHS DISCUSSED NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS PARAMETERS WITH PIC. PIC WILL DISCONTINUE PROCESS FOR NOW AND UNDERSTANDS WRITTEN PROCEDURES SHOULD BE SUBMITTED TO AND APPROVED BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT IF THE FACILITY WANTS TO CONTINUE PROCESS.
